sources_used: web search (Reddit maimai AU, Facebook Timezone/iPlay, site:arcadebelgium.be)

findings.name: Timezone Charlestown
findings.evidence_quote: maimai DX International Version search for Australia returns 47 stores; TIMEZONE Charlestown is not among them. Timezone chain marketing lists Mai Mai / DDR A / Pop'n Music as product types, not per-store inventory.
findings.note: Open Timezone FEC. ZIv only lists Injustice Arcade. No per-location rhythm proof; not on official AU maimai ALL.Net list. Do not assume chain-level rhythm catalogue applies here.

findings.name: Timezone Fountain Gate
findings.evidence_quote: Packed with arcade games... Team up on Nerf Arcade... Hot Wheels Unleashed... Ice.Ball... Virtual Rabbids... Space Invaders. 60+ arcade games, immersive VR experiences and redemption and prize games.
findings.note: Official venue page highlights redemption/VR/racing only. Not on AU maimai ALL.Net (47 stores). ZIv cabs are non-rhythm racers/shooters. Rhythm status unknown.

findings.name: Timezone Mandurah
findings.evidence_quote: Australia maimai DX list includes TIMEZONE(NORTHBRIDGE), TIMEZONE FREMANTLE, IPLAY CAROUSEL, VARSITY WATERFORD; no TIMEZONE Mandurah entry.
findings.note: WA Timezone. ZIv notes Asphalt racers only. No rhythm evidence found for this branch.

findings.name: Timezone Rockhampton
findings.evidence_quote: Australia maimai DX list (47 stores) has no Rockhampton / regional QLD Timezone beyond major SE QLD / metro entries.
findings.note: ZIv lists Mario Kart GP DX, Super Bikes 3, Wangan 6RR only. No rhythm sources found.

findings.name: Townsville Tenpin & Fun Centre
findings.evidence_quote: Townsville Tenpin is the place to be! Try Tenpin Bowling; Squash Courts; Dodgems are here!
findings.note: Site markets bowling, squash, dodgems. No rhythm game mention and no public machine list. Cannot confirmed_none without positive 'no music games' statement.

findings.name: Tunzafun Dandenong
findings.evidence_quote: TunzaFun Dandenong venue page focuses on party packages and general arcade/FEC activities; no machine-level rhythm list.
findings.note: ZIv cabs: GRID, NASCAR, Terminator, Transformers, Wangan 6RR. Not on AU maimai ALL.Net. Some TunzaFun sites rebranded to Timezone elsewhere; this Dandenong listing remains TunzaFun.

findings.name: Universal Games
findings.evidence_quote: 18-year-old Sam Pilgrim is ready to welcome customers to Universal Games at The Wharf Mooloolaba... There's something for everyone at Universal Games.
findings.note: Small waterfront FEC (opened ~2022). ZIv: Daytona USA, Stacker, Time Crisis II. No rhythm evidence. Current inventory not independently verified in 2026.

findings.name: Village Cinema Century City
findings.evidence_quote: ARCHIE BROTHERS CCW 285 Springvale Road, Glen Waverley, Victoria is on the AU maimai list. Village Cinema Century City is a different venue at the same Century City Walk complex.
findings.note: Do NOT attach Archie Brothers CCW maimai to this Village Cinema entry. ZIv only notes Wangan 6RR for Village Cinema Century City. Cinema lobby arcade status for rhythm: unknown.

findings.name: Village Cinema Fountain Gate
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv notes for this venue: Daytona Championship USA; NASCAR Arcade (no music/rhythm titles).
findings.note: Cinema arcade; not on AU maimai ALL.Net. No newer player reports found listing rhythm games.

findings.name: Village Cinemas Airport West
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv notes: Daytona USA (2P); Ghost Squad; Initial D ARCADE STAGE 4; Stacker; The Amazing Road Trip.
findings.note: Cinema arcade racers/shooters only on ZIv. Not on AU maimai list. No rhythm evidence.

findings.name: Village M-City
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv notes: Wangan Midnight Maximum Tune 6RR only among listed cabs.
findings.note: Clayton VIC cinema arcade. No rhythm sources found.

findings.name: Welcome to Thornbury
findings.evidence_quote: Formerly operated by the now retired Arcade Garage until mid 2025. Currently operated by Totally Game. Games: Super Bikes 2; Wangan Midnight Maximum Tune 6RR; Aliens Armageddon; Halo Fireteam Raven (2P).
findings.note: Totally Game operates other VIC venues with maimai (e.g. Southland per Reddit), but this High St Northcote floor list has no rhythm cabs. Do not import another Totally Game store's lineup.

findings.name: Windsor Castle Hotel
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv notes: Cruis'n Blast; MotoGP Arcade.
findings.note: Pub with a couple of racers. No rhythm evidence.

findings.name: Woodys Skate And Play
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv notes: Ace Driver Victory Lap; Daytona USA (2P); Final Furlong.
findings.note: Glenorchy TAS skate/play venue. Racing cabs only on ZIv. No rhythm sources found.

findings.name: Zone Bowling Liverpool
findings.evidence_quote: 45+ of the most iconic arcade games and attractions, like pool tables, Dizzy Chicken, Down the Clown, Piano Keys and more!
findings.note: Open Zone Bowling with arcade. Official copy names redemption/skill games only. Not on AU maimai ALL.Net (other Zone Bowling stores like Top Ryde/Blacktown/Villawood/Southland ARE listed). Piano Keys is not a mapped bemani slug.

findings.name: Zone Bowling Loganholme
findings.evidence_quote: AU maimai list includes ZONEBOWLING(GARDEN CITY) and other Zone/Kingpin sites; Loganholme / Hyperdome not listed.
findings.note: Active Zone Bowling venue (still in chain locator). No per-site rhythm proof.

findings.name: Zone Bowling Noarlunga
findings.evidence_quote: Zone Bowling Noarlunga is the place for unbeatable fun. Enjoy Glow in the Dark Bowling, Hyped Arcade Games, Memorable Birthday Parties.
findings.note: SA Zone Bowling. Not on AU maimai ALL.Net. No specific rhythm titles found.

findings.name: iPlay - Redbank
findings.evidence_quote: Music & Dance: Groove to your heart's content on one of our epic Dance Dance Revolution games... Rainbow readers... may include games like Wizard of Oz, Dance Dance Revolution, Mia Mia or Maximum Tune.
findings.note: Chain-level 'may include' DDR/maimai text is NOT per-location proof. AU maimai ALL.Net lists IPLAY CAROUSEL and (historically) Wetherill Park, not Redbank. ZIv notes only Wangan 6 for Redbank.

findings.name: iPlay Eastern Creek
findings.evidence_quote: iPlay Eastern Creek features bumper cars, an interactive Pixel floor arcade, a large dedicated claw machine area, and classic arcade games... more than 100 arcade games.
findings.note: Large FEC open. Official ECQ page does not name DDR/maimai. Not on AU maimai ALL.Net. Rhythm presence unknown.

findings.name: iPlay TTenpin City Coffs Harbour
findings.evidence_quote: AU maimai DX store list has no Coffs Harbour / Tenpin City entry.
findings.note: iPlay bowling+arcade at Coffs. No machine-level rhythm sources found.

findings.name: iPlay Whitfords
findings.evidence_quote: IPLAY CAROUSEL SHOP MM223, 1382 ALBANY HWY, CANNINGTON, WA is on the AU maimai list; Whitfords / Hillarys is not.
findings.note: Different WA iPlay from Carousel. Do not copy Carousel maimai. No Whitfords-specific rhythm evidence.

findings.name: Prater
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv notes: OutRun 2; Sega Rally Championship. Address given as 1020 Vienna (Prater amusement area).
findings.note: Generic Prater / Vienna fairground entry, not a named music-game venue. No maimai/DDR/pump hits for this ZIv id. Inventory likely incomplete/stale.

findings.name: Artec Game Center
findings.evidence_quote: Games listed (last update 19/01/2025): Aliens Armageddon, Bowling Party, Cruis'n Blast, Derby Day, Flying Tickets, Fun on Track, Lucky Pong Challenge, Pop the Lock, Smash It, Time Crisis 5 Mastermind Edition, Winter X Games SnoCross. No music/rhythm titles.
findings.note: Specialist Arcade Belgium inventory for Shopping 1 Genk is racers/shooters/redemption only. ZIv also had Piano Blocks III historically; not on 2025-01 AB list. Treat as FEC without bemani-class rhythm as of that update.

findings.name: Big Ben Beach
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv notes: Cactus Canyon; Silent Scope EX; Time Crisis II; Virtua Striker 4 ver. 2006.
findings.note: Koksijde beach arcade. Stale ZIv, no modern rhythm sources. Status and lineup unverified.

findings.name: Bobbejaanland
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: 舞立方·秀 120Hz (DANCE³ Show 120hz) (China). Comment: This is NOT the Chinese version, but a export version, fully translated and online and updated, but features no WeChat login. Updated 2025-07-26 by Firebird. Consists of two small arcades inside the park... The one with Dance3 Show 120hz is from arctec game center.
findings.note: DANCE³ Show is an IGS/Chinese dance rhythm cab; no matching named slug in allowed list so mapped to other. Photos on ZIv. Not maimai/DDR/pump.

findings.name: Brussels Indoor Games Center (BIGc)
findings.evidence_quote: Viens t'éclater dans les 200 m² de l'Arcade Zone de BIGc! Découvre des jeux d'arcade classiques et modernes pour tous les âges... Plus de 30 jeux d'arcade.
findings.note: Large multi-activity centre (laser, bowling, karaoke, arcade). Site claims 30+ arcade games but names none. No rhythm-specific evidence.

findings.name: Comic Sans
findings.evidence_quote: Belgium's Geek-Bar!... The seperate Gameroom has 4 big screen tv's with 4 Xbox One's and 2 Nintendo Switches. Other than that we have 6 Pinballmachines and several board/cardgames which you can play anytime! Games listed: Stern pinballs, Pac-Man Battle Royale, Challenge, Pool Table.
findings.note: Pinball/console geek bar in Gent (cafecomicsans.be). Venue self-description and ZIv inventory are pinball + home consoles + pool; no arcade rhythm cabinets.

findings.name: Crosly Bowling
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv entry for Crosly Bowling, Boulevard de l'Empereur 36 Brussels; no games listed on shard notes.
findings.note: Bowling centre with possible side arcade. No current public rhythm inventory. Stale/empty ZIv.

findings.name: GameTown Kempense Meren
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Danz Base SEA Edition (Asia). Price ??? Condition Unknown. Part of Sunparks Kempense Meren. Updated 2025-05-27 by Firebird.
findings.note: IGS Danz Base is a motion dance rhythm cab; mapped to other. Condition unknown on ZIv; no second source. Sunparks holiday-park FEC.

findings.name: L'Ondin
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv notes: After Burner; The King of Fighters 2001.
findings.note: Ans (Liège) bar/arcade entry, very stale. No modern confirmation of open status or rhythm cabs.

findings.name: Lillys Casino
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv notes long list of older racers/fighters (18 Wheeler, Aqua Jet, Daytona USA, F355, Manx TT, Ridge Racer V, Scud Race, Sega Rally 2, KOF XI, etc.) at Bellewaerde address.
findings.note: Bellewaerde theme-park arcade nickname. No named bemani/rhythm titles in notes. Inventory age unknown.

findings.name: Luna Park Reflex
findings.evidence_quote: We have been one of the biggest arcades in Belgium since 1985... state-of-the-art VR games... coinpushers... claw machines... pinball machines... Stern pinball machines. Coinpushers, pinballs, racers, VR games. We have it all! (ZIv information block).
findings.note: Large Oostende arcade still open. Marketing lists VR/coinpushers/claws/pinball; ZIv documents Stern pinballs only. No explicit rhythm/DDR/maimai evidence, so unknown not confirmed_none.

findings.name: Lunapark
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv notes: Skylanders Cloud Patrol; Star Wars: Racer Arcade; The Maze of the Kings; Time Crisis II. Website field points at bobbejaanland.be.
findings.note: Likely older/alternate Bobbejaanland park arcade stub (Olensteenweg Kasterlee). May overlap z10335. Do not merge lineups without confirmation. No rhythm on this stub.

findings.name: Marco Polo
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv notes: Rage Racer; The King of Fighters '98: The Slugfest.
findings.note: Angleur (Liège) venue. Stale ZIv. No rhythm evidence.

findings.name: Player (Chênée)
findings.evidence_quote: Excellent game shop with an arcade! Used to have a Beatmania III THE FINAL arcade, which they sold in late 2013 to an undisclosed private person. Current listed games: D&D Tower of Doom; Capcom vs SNK 2; SFIII 3rd Strike; KOF XIII. Updated 2014-08-30.
findings.note: Historically sold its only documented music game (BMIII) in 2013. 2014 fighter-only list is too old to call confirmed_none or closed. Current open status not verified.

findings.name: Shoryu Game
findings.evidence_quote: Specialist fighting game arcade. Has Killer Instinct 2, quite rare. Games: KI2; SFIII 3rd Strike; Super SF2 Turbo; SSF4 AE; KOF 98; KOF XIII. Updated 2013-10-01.
findings.note: Fighting-only ZIv from 2013. Facebook page still exists by name but open status and modern inventory not proven. Too stale for confirmed_none.

findings.name: The Bowl Factory (Braine-l'Alleud)
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv notes: Area 51; Sega Rally Championship; Virtua Striker 4 ver. 2006.
findings.note: Bowling venue with old arcade cabs on ZIv. No rhythm evidence.

findings.name: The House of Fun
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv visitor inventory 2024-06-15: Mario Kart GP DX, NFS Heat Takedown, Super Bikes 3, Jurassic Park Arcade, Stern pinballs, many redemption/claw/skill games, pool; website gamehall FAQ: race- and shootergames, basketball, airhockey, pool, darts. No music game listed.
findings.note: Strong negative inventory for bemani-class games but not an explicit 'no rhythm games' policy. Left as unknown rather than confirmed_none per supreme rule.

findings.name: Happyland Mall Plaza Calama
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv notes: Daytona USA (2P); Jurassic Park: The Lost World. Shard note: country corrected from coordinates (Chile -> Bolivia) — address is Mall Plaza Calama, Chile Antofagasta region.
findings.note: Happyland FEC chain (Chile). Coordinates/address are Calama, Chile, not Bolivia. No rhythm titles in ZIv notes. No local language confirmation of pump/DDR/maimai found for this store.
